title: Jolt preview input
description: A source document to preview a Jolt transformer with, along with the values that its custom methods return in the preview. Input files for orders.jolt.json are kept in .jolt/orders/ next to it.

input.description: The source document to run the transformer against.

mocks.description: The values that custom methods return in the preview, by method name, since their implementations are in the host application. Calling a custom method that's listed in a .jolt/methods.json file without a mock is an error.

returns.description: The value that every call to the method returns, whatever its arguments.
